source: docs/plans/wildbond-world-design.md (section 3, banner table and before-routes paragraph)

fit.note: The walking box is 344px wide with 4px padding on each side in objective.gd. Budget one full 8px em per printable ASCII character: floor((344 - 8) / 8) = 42 characters on one line. This is a conservative estimate, not a measurement of Godot ThemeDB.fallback_font or a rendered accessibility review.

integration.owner: The clarity PR and later world phases; no runtime loading is added here.
integration.selection: Use beforeRoutes until the named route and place signs actually exist in the player build. Switch only the affected row as its world phase lands; badge count alone does not select afterRoutes. Row 5 also needs the intended Bellstep cave connections to work; retain each mouth's own gate, including depthReturns, rather than promising every mouth is open. Row 8 names Trialstair, so Trial Road or its sign alone is insufficient: that cave connection must also be usable.
integration.opening: Badge count 0 applies only after the first wild catch; preserve the existing introduction, partner-choice, first-catch and full-screen/battle suppression rules.
integration.order: These rows follow the current ordered eight-badge journey. The later open-order phase must select an unmet destination by badge identity, not just count.
integration.champion: Badge count 8 is pre-Champion league guidance. Preserve Champion/post-game handling separately; this file does not choose an ending or Spire objective.
integration.letters: Keep ranch news and one direction in Maren's existing letter; no errand list, new tracker or quest/save field.
integration.copy: sourceCopy preserves section 3 verbatim without its parenthetical editorial notes. afterRoutes joins the two-sentence examples and shortens banners to one sentence within the estimate; beforeRoutes substitutes the current map names and walks. Maren lines are also single sentences; only badge 0 retains {starter}.
integration.review: All copy remains proposed for Wildbond lead review. The wiring PR must inspect the actual screen, font, wrapping and accessibility; no new lore clue is placed. The 344px estimate does not cover the 328px speech-card layout; the wiring PR must measure that narrower case too, including its existing height reuse.
